topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This topic frames the lecture by outlining its learning objectives, historical context, and the multi-step progression model of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signal autonomy and signaling pathway deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase and Wnt/beta-catenin pathways enable growth factor independence and sustained proliferative signaling.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations disrupt terminal differentiation to preserve a proliferative progenitor state in both hematopoietic lineages and the intestinal epithelium.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis through p53 and Bcl-2 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms by which cancer cells disable programmed cell death through alterations in p53, Bax, and anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, telomere maintenance, and senescence bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the limits of normal cellular replication, how telomerase reactivation bypasses senescence, and how cellular stress signals converge on p53 to enforce arrest.

topics.label: Complex cancer hallmarks and metabolic reprogramming
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics transition to complex hallmarks and explain how tumor cells rewire metabolic pathways, such as aerobic glycolysis and the Krebs cycle, to support cellular growth and epigenetic changes.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how growing tumors overcome oxygen and nutrient diffusion limits by switching on new blood vessel recruitment.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dissemination, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the biological cascade of metastatic dissemination, longitudinal monitoring via liquid biopsies, environmental determinants of colonization, and associated genomic features.

topics.label: Lecture summary and conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture with a summary of the hallmarks of cancer and final administrative remarks.
